g.text: Directive 2002/58/EC (amended 2009) — 27 different national implementations. Lex specialis over GDPR.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: In force: 11 Jan 2024 | Applicable: 12 Sep 2025 | NOT primarily a privacy law — governs data access.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Mandatory (not optional) before any high-risk processing. Almost every significant AI project triggers this.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Choose one before processing starts. Cannot change after.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: All processing must comply with all seven. No exceptions.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: What is personal data?

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. Lawfulness, Fairness & Transparency

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Legal basis + no deception + clear privacy notice

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Purpose Limitation ← most violated in AI

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Data for purpose A ≠ reusable for purpose B

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 'We have the data' ≠ 'We may train on it'

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. Data Minimisation

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Collect only what is strictly necessary

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Define data fields upfront — no bulk ingestion

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Accuracy

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Inaccurate training data → discriminatory outputs

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Individuals have right to correction

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Storage Limitation

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Defined retention periods. Deleting source data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: may not 'forget' it from a trained model.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Integrity & Confidentiality (Security)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Encryption, access controls, audit logs,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: AI output security testing

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. Accountability

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Demonstrate compliance. Written policies, DPIAs,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: audit logs. 'We think we comply' is not enough.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Key provisions:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: USER ACCESS (Art. 3-7)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Users have right to access data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: generated by their connected products.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Free, easy, machine-readable format.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Products must be accessible by default.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: THIRD-PARTY SHARING (Art. 8-12)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Data holders must share under FRAND

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: terms (fair, reasonable, non-discriminatory)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: if user wants to share with third party.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Third party cannot resell or build

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: a competing product.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: PUBLIC SECTOR ACCESS (Art. 15-26)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Last resort: emergency response, public

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: health threat, disaster recovery only.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Mandatory for: systematic profiling with significant effects | large-scale special category data

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: systematic monitoring of public areas | use of innovative technologies (= most AI)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: DPIA must cover:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Description of processing and purposes

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Assessment of necessity and proportionality

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Identification of risks to data subjects

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Measures to address those risks

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: If residual risk remains HIGH → must consult supervisory authority before proceeding.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Consulting rule: Build DPIA into project timeline from day one — not as a pre-launch afterthought.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. RIGHT TO BE INFORMED (Art.13-14)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Privacy notice at collection: what, why, basis,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: retention, sharing, automated decisions.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. RIGHT OF ACCESS (Art.15)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Copy of all data + logic info. Answer within 1 month.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. RIGHT TO RECTIFICATION (Art.16)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Correct inaccurate data. May require model retraining.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. RIGHT TO ERASURE / 'RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN' (Art.17)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Technically complex: deleting source ≠ forgetting model.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Active area of regulatory development.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. RIGHT TO RESTRICTION (Art.18)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Restrict processing while accuracy is contested.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. RIGHT TO DATA PORTABILITY (Art.20)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Machine-readable format (consent/contract + automated).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. RIGHT TO OBJECT (Art.21)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Object to legitimate interests. Direct marketing:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: must stop IMMEDIATELY, no exceptions.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 8. AUTOMATED DECISION-MAKING (Art.22)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Right not to be subject to solely automated decisions

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: with legal or significant effects.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Requires: human intervention + right to contest +

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: right to explanation. Must be genuine, not rubber stamp.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: CONSENT — freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: High bar: no pre-ticking, no bundling. Hard retroactively.

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Cannot be used for special category data.

g.text: Cannot override ePrivacy consent requirements.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Any info relating to an identified / identifiable natural person.

g.text: 8 RULES EVERY AI CONSULTANT MUST KNOW

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1. "We already have the data" ≠ "we can train AI on it"

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Risk-classify first, design second (AI Act tier → architecture)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. ePrivacy TRUMPS GDPR for tracking — no LI substitute

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. Deployers of third-party AI inherit obligations (can't outsource

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: accountability to the model provider)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. Explainability is a LEGAL requirement (Art.22 + AI Act)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. Cross-border transfers need documented mechanisms (SCCs)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: — commonly missing in vendor contracts, check every time

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. Document every compliance decision in writing (client records)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 8. Know which Omnibus IS and IS NOT law:

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ✓ AI Omnibus: provisional agreement May 7, 2026 — plan for it

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ✗ Data Omnibus (GDPR/ePrivacy/Data Act): trilogue, NOT law

g.text: SCENARIO 1: CV SCREENING & RECRUITMENT AI

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Laws triggered: GDPR + AI Act (High Risk Annex III) + ePrivacy

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • NOT a grey area — recruitment AI is explicitly Annex III

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • GDPR: lawful basis for CVs (contract/LI); special category alert

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (disability, ethnicity often inferable); DPIA mandatory; Art.22

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: must be representative (gender, age, ethnicity, disability); logs

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: retained ≥6 months; register in EU AI public database

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • Deadline: under Digital Omnibus on AI (agreed May 7, 2026)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (purpose limitation!); Art.22 if chatbot influences account decisions

g.text: SCENARIO 4: AI PERSONALISATION FOR E-COMMERCE

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Laws: ePrivacy (primary gate) + GDPR + AI Act (minimal/limited)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • ePrivacy is the gate: before any behavioural data can be

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: collected for personalisation AI, valid ePrivacy consent required

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • ePrivacy: consent must be prior, specific to personalisation

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (not bundled with 'analytics'), freely given, withdrawable;

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: no-consent users must get unpersonalised experience without penalty

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • GDPR: detailed behavioural profiles = 'profiling' (Art.4(4));

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: absolute right to object to profiling for direct marketing;

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: document profiling in records of processing

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: • AI Act: recommendation AI = typically Minimal Risk; BUT dynamic

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: pricing (different prices per user) → fairness concerns → Limited

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Risk; transparency about AI-driven pricing advisable

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Practical guidance:

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: → Build personalisation engine with 'no consent' mode (required)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: → Architect consent signals into data pipeline — real-time effect

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: → Review consent banner UX with legal counsel before launch

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: → Do NOT design for proposed cookie relaxation (still trilogue)

text.font-family: Cascadia, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
